# Lumen8

> Lumen8 is a geospatial planning engine and a feasibility-study service for clean power and energy access:
> utility-scale solar and storage, mini-grids and rural electrification programmes. Lumen8 sells fixed-price
> feasibility studies (pre-feasibility screens, full feasibility studies, programme plans) built on the engine, gives
> study customers access to the platform at app.lumen8.ai, and offers an agent API (REST and MCP) at api.lumen8.ai.

Results are planning and feasibility estimates that name their data sources and assumptions; they are not a detailed
engineering design or an independent engineer's report.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lumen8.ai/): what Lumen8 does, the engine and the modules
- [Feasibility studies](https://lumen8.ai/studies.html): scope, deliverables, timeline, how to request a study
- [Utility-scale solar and storage](https://lumen8.ai/utility-scale.html): site screening to feasibility for PV and battery plants
- [Rural electrification](https://lumen8.ai/rural-electrification.html): national village screening, ranking and mini-grid design
- [Modules](https://lumen8.ai/modules.html): every module of the platform (wind, hydro, geothermal, agriculture, telecoms, maritime and more)
